The uniform archived witness also describes opposite-input-infinity after intermediate overflow, whose legacy-versus-precise interpretation is not itself an acceptance criterion. Source is not repaired. Unversioned npx Prettier is attempted with unavailable plugin; no installation warning or pinned dependency mutation is observed.
